A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LaviGen work, including matching main text and supplementary material. Overlapping appendix text in v2 remains recoverable through extraction, allowing reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark and ablation results in Table 1, qualitative experiments, and a 43-participant user study in Table 2.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, ablation, qualitative and user-study results, including supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 3 and 6 and Algorithm 1 retain the same autoregressive diffusion model, identity-aware embedding, dual-guidance self-rollout distillation and object-fitting procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training datasets and LayoutVLM benchmark. Layout completion, editing and larger-scene examples are also retained without changes in coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 and Figure 5 retain LayoutGPT, Holodeck, I-Design and LayoutVLM. Table 2 retains the same LayoutGPT and LayoutVLM comparisons, and the supplementary TRELLIS comparison is unchanged.

E3.justification: Training settings, evaluation metrics and the 8–10-object benchmark protocol remain unchanged. The user study still comprises 43 participants answering 10 questions each, yielding 430 responses.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 1 and Figure 7 are unchanged. Sections 7.1–7.3 retain the same scalability, backbone-generalization and generation-diversity analyses and examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for the experimental results. Tables 1 and 2 retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are retained. For example, Table 1 reports the same full-model CF of 97.3, IB of 98.6, PSA of 78.8 and inference time of 24.3 seconds in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 and their mathematical definitions and derivations are unchanged. No formal assumptions, theoretical results or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and scope, including native-3D autoregressive layout generation and the claims of 19% higher physical plausibility and 65% faster computation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of exposure bias and component effects are unchanged. Section 8 retains the limitations concerning 64^3 voxel resolution for small objects and insufficient annotations for semantic consistency; its text is relocated, not revised.

D1.justification: Section 6 retains the same architecture, hardware, optimization, training and sampling details. The code and project-page links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and all 105 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 removes Chunchao Guo and the Tencent Hunyuan affiliation, adjusts affiliation numbering and adds funding acknowledgments before the references. The scientific narrative is unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block and appendix layout change, including resizing or repositioning Figures 8–10 and reflowing Section 8. On v2 page 10, headings and paragraphs around Sections 7.3 and 8 overlap, impairing legibility; the underlying figure and table content is retained.

improvement.justification: The scientific evidence and reasoning are unchanged. Although v2 adds funding acknowledgments, its page 10 overlaps generation-diversity and limitations text that was legible in v1, producing a localized but clear loss of readability.
